anomalies.observed: Both the ATtiny45 (U2) and ATtiny13 (U3) are connected pin-for-pin to the same nets, including shared reset, I/O, ground, and supply. In particular, both PB1 pins drive the PWM net and both PB0 pins connect to SDA.
anomalies.expected: A fan controller should use one MCU to drive these shared signals, or provide an explicit mutually exclusive population/selection arrangement. Two MCUs connected in parallel can contend on outputs and behave unpredictably.
